known_limitations: If the uploaded PNG itself contains large transparent margins around the actual strokes, the signature will still look small inside the 50×20 mm box. The renderer intentionally does NOT crop the source file — this preserves the user's uploaded original. Fix by uploading a tightly-cropped PNG.
The size constants (50 mm × 20 mm) are inline in pdf/invoice.py. If future tuning is needed, adjust in one place and re-run the guard test.
